2610.06844.title: Learning to Read the Contextual Tokens in Diffusion Transformers
2610.06844.paper_summary: Multimodal Diffusion Transformers (MM-DiTs) jointly process visual and textual representations throughout generation. These models repeatedly update the text tokens through multimodal attention, forming dynamic contextual tokens whose function is not well understood. In this work, we introduce a framework for reading this contextual space through natural-language interrogation. We train a lightweight bottleneck network that maps intermediate contextual tokens into the input space of a frozen Large Language Model (LLM), allowing the LLM to answer questions about the emerging image directly from these hidden representations. Our reader reveals that contextual tokens encode a rich, global representation of the emerging scene: generation-specific semantics, including attributes left underspecified by the prompt, are accessible surprisingly early in denoising, while increasingly fine-grained details become readable over time. Remarkably, this information remains decodable even when the MM-DiT receives an empty prompt, showing that contextual tokens accumulate substantial image-specific information from the evolving visual representation itself. We further find that generations with more readable contextual representations tend to receive higher human-preference scores. Building on these observations, we introduce Contextual Alignment, a training technique that explicitly reinforces the visual-semantic information encoded in the contextual tokens, improving generation quality and distributional coverage. Together, our results establish contextual tokens as both an interpretable view into the internal dynamics of MM-DiTs and an effective target for improving generative models.
2610.06844.paper_summary_zh: 多模態擴散Transformer（MM-DiTs）在生成過程中共同處理視覺和文本表示。這些模型通過多模態注意力不斷更新文本標記，形成動態上下文標記，其功能尚不清楚。在這項工作中，我們引入了一個通過自然語言詢問來閱讀這個上下文空間的框架。我們訓練了一個輕量級瓶頸網絡，將中間上下文標記映射到一個凍結的大型語言模型（LLM）的輸入空間，使得LLM能夠直接從這些隱藏表示中回答有關新興圖像的問題。我們的讀取器揭示了上下文標記編碼了新興場景的豐富全球表示：生成特定的語義，包括提示中未明確的屬性，令人驚訝地在去噪過程中早期就可以訪問，而隨著時間的推移，越來越細緻的細節變得可讀。值得注意的是，即使MM-DiT接收到空提示，這些信息仍然可以解碼，顯示上下文標記從不斷演變的視覺表示中積累了大量特定於圖像的信息。我們進一步發現，具有更可讀上下文表示的生成通常會獲得更高的人類偏好分數。在這些觀察的基礎上，我們引入了上下文對齊，一種明確加強上下文標記中編碼的視覺-語義信息的訓練技術，從而改善生成質量和分佈覆蓋率。總的來說，我們的結果確立了上下文標記作為對MM-DiTs內部動態的可解釋視圖以及改善生成模型的有效目標。
